hypothesis: The already-accepted Voice components compose on the owner VPS with real local ASR and headless local TTS without cross-boundary causal authority violations in the four highest-information full-duplex scenarios.
counterhypothesis: Real local model timing/output reveals a cross-boundary race not visible in packet-only CI: HOLD closes a turn, post-cancel TTS chunks leak into output authority, simultaneous user speech leaves stale output/tool ownership, or restart resurrects a late tool result.
acceptance: All four scenarios execute against one exact subject/runtime identity with no counterexample and explicit bounded observables. A PRODUCT_NEGATIVE may justify repair; infra/evidence failures must not trigger new architecture by default.
next_exact_action: Route this unchanged semantic key to Trigger 4 for exactly one owner-VPS integration execution. Do not create new Voice components unless the exact executed discriminator yields PRODUCT_NEGATIVE that cannot be repaired by composition/wiring/configuration of existing authorities.
